Light backgrounds pair with dark text; dark backgrounds pair with light text. * **Near-white surfaces:** use `#FEFEFE`, never `#FFFFFF` (e.g., the highlighted pricing card in light mode). ### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode * Dark mode is **required**, implemented purely through the CSS variable blocks above — zero HTML restructuring. * **Theme toggle** in the header: a 44×44px icon button using Material Symbols `dark_mode` / `light_mode`, with `aria-pressed` and a dynamic `aria-label` ("Switch to dark theme" / "Switch to light theme"). * **Persistence (`script.js`):** On load, read `localStorage.getItem('theme')`. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES * **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` type and spacing; breakpoints 640/768/1024px; zero horizontal overflow; all touch targets ≥44×44px. * **Smooth animations:** every state change uses `transition: var(--transition-normal)` — hover lifts, chevron rotation, accordion expansion, button press scale. Optional scroll-reveal via `IntersectionObserver` adding `.is-visible` (content fully visible without JS; completely disabled under reduced motion). * **Reduced motion:** under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`, transitions and animations are minimized to near-zero and `scroll-behavior` reverts to auto. * **Accessibility:** skip link; section landmarks with `aria-labelledby`; contrast ≥4.5:1 for body text and ≥3:1 for large text/UI components in **both** themes; never rely on color alone — pair icons and text with every state; `:focus-visible` rings (2px `--focus-ring`, offset 2px) on every interactive element; full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions); decorative icons `aria-hidden`; correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` on the theme toggle, mobile nav, and FAQ; `aria-live="polite"` region for theme-change announcements. * **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and focus produces a visible state change. * **Destructive actions:** `.btn--danger` must be defined and visually distinct in both light and dark themes. --- ## 4.
